acceptance_criteria: AC-1: gate.decide() allows 'git worktree add' in interactive form only (new entry in INTERACTIVE_EXTRA_PREFIXES), mirroring the existing 'git checkout -b gov/po-' write-action precedent -- delegated form continues to deny it (falls through to the existing 'command prefix not in the PO allowlist' denial, no special-case needed).

AC-2: 'git worktree add' is restricted by a new, specific check (not merely the prefix match): the base ref argument (the commit-ish 'git worktree add <path> <commit-ish> [-b <branch>]' takes) must start with 'origin/' -- exactly mirroring the existing 'git merge origin/<ref>' restriction so no arbitrary local path, remote, or URL is ever reachable as a worktree base (git remote add stays unavailable, as today).

AC-3: when '-b <branch>' is present, the new branch name must start with 'feature/' -- explicitly excluding 'gov/po-' (that prefix is reserved for the PO's own governance branch via the existing 'git checkout -b gov/po-' path, not for worktrees handed to an engineer) and excluding any other prefix. A worktree add without '-b' (attaching an existing branch) is allowed without this check.
AC-4: 'git worktree list' is added to COMMON_PREFIXES (both forms, read-only, mirroring 'git branch --list').

AC-5: 'git worktree remove', 'git worktree prune', and 'git worktree move' are explicitly NOT added to any allowlist -- they stay denied by the existing default-deny path. A worktree, once created, is never destroyed by the PO role in this movement's scope; removal is a human or engineer action, or a future separately-justified movement.

AC-6: new targeted tests in tests/test_gov_po_role.py cover: interactive 'git worktree add ../x origin/main -b feature/y' allowed; the same command in delegated form denied; a base ref not starting with 'origin/' denied (e.g. a local path or a different remote) in interactive form; a '-b' branch name not starting with 'feature/' denied (including an attempted 'gov/po-' branch name) in interactive form; 'git worktree add ../x origin/main' (no -b) allowed; 'git worktree list' allowed in both forms; 'git worktree remove'/'prune'/'move' denied in both forms.

AC-7: every existing test in tests/test_gov_po_role.py keeps passing unmodified; no other decide() branch (Agent, Edit/Write governance paths, relay/*.json pattern, existing git-write branch check, --body-file, RELAY_MARKERS) changes behavior.

baseline.authority: This session's own established pattern (GOV_PO_1_GATE_1 through GATE_4): a narrow, justified allowlist addition to scripts/nexus_po_tool_gate.py, mirroring an already-shipped precedent (here: the existing 'git merge origin/<ref>' remote-restriction pattern and the 'git checkout -b gov/po-' write-action pattern).
baseline.sequencing: Product Owner direction (2026-09-08): future engineering movements should run in isolated git worktrees (separate physical checkouts) rather than sharing this session's single checkout, after two same-checkout collision risks were caught and avoided in real use this session (gov_po_1_gate_3 vs m10_1; the paused gov_po_1_local_relay_watch_command vs gov_po_2_freeze_and_merge).
